Download `Cells.exe` and run it. It offers to install itself for your Windows user without admin rights: it goes to the Start menu, starts with Windows in the tray and can be removed from Settings > Apps like any other app. The exe carries its own .NET runtime, so nothing else needs to be installed. Choose "Just run it" to keep it portable.

Hover the tray icon to see the battery level of every device it found, click the icon to choose which devices that card lists, and right-click it for the widget, theme, alerts and the rest. Windows 11 puts new tray icons behind the arrow, so drag Cells onto the taskbar once.

The supported devices are listed in the README. If yours is missing, pick "Save device report" in the tray menu and attach the file to an issue.
